'''New Coral City''' was a [[city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[ocean]] [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren]] [[species]], that existed by [[20 BBY]]. Primarily [[Color|gray]] in color, it consisted of a central tower that sloped down into a wide, circular base with a number of jetties and piers extending from it. Smaller towers dotted the lower areas of the central area and some of the extensions.<ref name="Galactic Atlas" />

Although most of Mon Cala's residents lived in cities [[Water|underwater]], New Coral City floated above an ocean's surface with a large glacier underneath it. An illustration of the city was included on a [[map]] of Mon Cala thought to have been drawn by the [[artist]] [[Gammit Chond]] based on travelers' tales. The map was later restored and published by the [[Graf Archive]] at some point after [[34 ABY]] in the ''[[Galactic Atlas]]''<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> as well as the later updated version of the [[book]].<ref name="Atlas Updated">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], New Coral City was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', a [[2016]] reference book written by [[Emil Fortune]] and illustrated by [[Tim McDonagh]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas" /> The [[New Coral City/Legends|city]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 22|twenty-second issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Alan Robinson]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref> on [[April 23]], [[2008]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54394/star_wars_legacy_2006_22|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #22}}</ref>
